name: Sreedhareeyam Ayurvedic Eye Hospital
summary: Sreedhareeyam is an Ayurvedic eye hospital and research centre at Koothattukulam, set up in 1999 and now a 342-bed hospital. It is NABH accredited and carries the Ayur Diamond classification of Kerala's Department of Tourism.
highlights: NABH accredited (certificate listed on the NABH portal)
Ayur Diamond classification, Department of Tourism, Government of Kerala
Centre of Excellence in Ayurvedic Ophthalmology, Ministry of AYUSH
Separate Panchakarma wing, with accommodation on site
